text: Varzisk Lidless is a skeleton located inside Nurakkir in Maldraxxus, where he offers daily quests to Necrolord players who have unlocked the Streaming Threads (Necrolord) upgrade.

The Vault of Souls is an underground area of the Sorcerous Steps. It is where Kel'Thuzad was experimenting to breach the Maw. Within the rooms, there are collections of items and artifacts from all the realms of the Shadowlands, including animacones and a Drust rune from Ardenweald, anima-runoff from Castle Nathria that created the Endmire from Revendreth, and various scrolls and bells from Bastion.

Vendor trash is a term for items which will most likely not be sold to any player and have little or no function in the game except to be sold to an NPC vendor for money, hence the term vendor trash, also known as "Junk" to some players. The term is somewhat subjective, but generally, most players agree that poor quality or "gray" items fall into this category. Common quality or "white" weapons and armor are often considered to be vendor trash as well. The key factors here are useless items have no demand and should be vended (non-equipable poor quality items are almost all useless) and low quality weapons and armor have low demand, but have high markup in the auction house, and are too expe

A vendor is an NPC who buys and sells items. Trainers are not technically vendors, even though they sell recipes, since they do not buy anything. The word is also sometimes used as a verb for selling to a vendor, e.g., "I'm just going to vendor this axe, since I can't use it." For quick use as a verb, sometimes only "V" is used to mean "vendor it" or "V?" for "vendor it?" Items that have no use other than selling to a vendor are called vendor trash. It is noteworthy that while most profession and food vendors are essential, most armor and weapon merchants are only as valuable as their repairs. This caravan travels from the Kolkar Village in the north to Mannoroc Coven in the south (where Super-Seller 680 appears). Supposedly, the caravan used to arrive here once an hour around the hour mark; but that schedule no longer applies, and the interval appears to simply be however long it takes to travel to the south and back. Vengeance Lift is an elevator up into the cliffs from Bleeding Vale and southwest of Vengeance Landing. A massive stone dragon head strikes out from the cliffs above Bleeding Vale, with a chain hanging from its mouth that runs two wood elevator cars up from the vale below. It's called the Vengeance Lift, no doubt for the nearby Horde town, but the lift is plainly vrykul-made. There are other lifts like it around Howling Fjord, including the Stonewall Lift to the south and the Westwind Lift to the west. During the war against the Lich King, the Forsaken forces fought with the vrykul for the control of the elevator.

Venomhide Poison is a temporary weapon enchantment that lasts for 5 minutes or 15 charges. If it procs upon a successful melee attack, it applies a poison debuff on the target. The debuff is, "Target takes 15 nature damage every 3 seconds," with a duration of 12 seconds.

It is unclear whether they are simply a different body type of common dragons, or a separate race altogether. __NOTOC__

The Vend-O-Tron D-Luxe is a trade goods and reagents vending fixed device found inside the gondola of zeppelins and in the starting area of the Horde version of Deadmines. In addition to offering a variety of goods, the machine can repair worn or damaged items. It will also accept items the user wishes to sell at standard vendor prices.

Vereesa Windrunner is the Ranger-General of the Silver Covenant. An elven ranger who fought throughout the Second and Third Wars, she is the youngest sister of Alleria and Sylvanas, widow of Archmage Rhonin Redhair, and mother of Giramar and Galadin. After becoming a ranger, she met Rhonin in an escort mission and together they helped free the Dragon Queen Alexstrasza from the Dragonmaw clan. Nearly all of Vereesa's extended family were killed by orcs in the Second War and in Prince Arthas's invasion of Quel'Thalas. .]] The Venture Co. Base Camp is the base of operations for the Venture Company, specifically those interested in Tumbled Crystals. Adjacent to this area is the Venture Co. Operations Center. As of the Cataclysm the entire area is now deforested, though the Venture Company and its lumber mill remains. During the Rise of the Zandalari, the place was overran by Jungle Serpents and goblins killed.

Venomweb Vale is a wide valley located in eastern Tirisfal Glades, just south of the Scarlet Monastery. While the vale used to be a haven for hunting deer and rabbits, its trees verdant and the grass green, it is now a tainted place full of poisonous and deadly spiders led by Sri'skulk which give the vale its new name. In the northern part of the valley, darkhounds roam near the Scarlet Encampment, a Scarlet Crusade camp under the command of Lieutenant Sanders.
Venya Marthand is Forsaken located in Deathknell of Tirisfal Glades.
Venomous Totem is a trinket for rogues that increases the damage dealt by some of their poisons.

.]] Verna Furlbrow was the wife of Farmer Furlbrow, who owned a pumpkin farm in northern Westfall. The couple decided to leave Westfall when their farm was overrun by the Defias Brotherhood, but their wagon broke down on the road to Elwynn. Stranded, they wound up squatting at the Jansen Stead for the next five years. Around the time of the Cataclysm, the Furlbrows and their horse, Old Blanchy, were found murdered near their cart at the Jansen Stead. Lieutenant Horatio Laine and some Stormwind Investigators were on the scene trying to discover what happened. The Furlbrows were killed on orders of Vanessa VanCleef because they recognized her.
